settings.question: How fast is shipping and when will I get my tracking code?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 24 hours. Express shipping delivers within 2–4 business days. As soon as your order leaves our warehouse, you receive an automated confirmation email with your direct tracking link.

settings.question: How does the 30-Day Money Back Guarantee work?
settings.answer: We offer a 100% risk-free trial. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with your Smozi purchase, simply contact our support team within 30 days of receiving your item for a full refund.

settings.question: Is my payment safe and secure?
settings.answer: Yes! All transactions are encrypted with 256-bit SSL encryption (the same standard used by major banks). We support all trusted payment providers including Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery.

settings.question: How can I contact the customer support team?
settings.answer: Our concierge support team is online 24/7. You can contact us anytime via our Contact page or directly at support@smozi.com. We answer all customer requests quickly, typically within 2 hours.
